use_case_summary: Veridian is an EU-headquartered ecommerce CX platform building a hybrid agent-assist + automation layer. Core asks: real-time ticket summarization for agents, automated tool-calls to internal billing and Zendesk to create/update tickets and issue refunds, and deterministic escalation rules. Spike resilience required for promotional events (x10 traffic peaks).
requirements_summary:
- Workloads: live agent suggestions (sub-300ms suggestion time), background ticket summarize jobs (batch), and synchronous tool-calls that mutate downstream systems.
- Throughput: baseline 200 reqs/min for agent-assist; peak targets up to 2,000 reqs/min during promotions (tool-calls mostly async but some synchronous refund ops).
- Latency: suggestion latency target <300ms P95; tool-call end-to-end for refunds allowed up to 3s with observability and retries.
- Reliability: must support graceful degradation (fallback to read-only model + human-only flow) and automatic fallback to backup region.
- Security: SAML SSO, audit logs for every tool-call, KMS-managed keys, EU data residency, retention controls (90-day short-term logs, 7-year audit storage).
- Integrations: Zendesk, internal billing REST API (no idempotency), Stripe for refunds, internal escalation queue (RabbitMQ).
latency_targets: suggestions: <300ms P95; ticket summarization: batch within 60s; synchronous refunds: <3s acceptable
throughput_targets: baseline 200 rpm agent-assist; peak 2k rpm during campaigns; 500 concurrent tool-call operations peak
model_preferences: prefer open/models hosted behind customer's VPC or Dedicated instances. Will evaluate quantized 8-bit variants for cost. Customer engineering prefers ability to pin model versions and rollback quickly.
integration_notes: Need SDK/endpoint patterns for idempotent tool-calls; suggested approach: request_id + at-most-once semantics + compensating actions. Also require tracing headers propagated to Zendesk/Stripe for auditability.
technical_notes:
- POC to exercise: create ticket via tool-call, issue partial refund via Stripe API through Redwood call, escalate to human and attach AI summary to ticket.
- SE asked for sample canary policy: 10% traffic -> 100% within 24h if success.
- Logging: token-level cost visibility required for C-suite showback.
